```{r}
source("R/site.R")
d = presentations()
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
items = vapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) talk_item(d[i, ]), "")
emit('<div class="filterable">',
     filter_controls("presentations",
                     buttons = setNames(c("All", "Talks", "Posters"), c("", "talk", "poster")),
                     flags   = c(invited = "Invited only")),
     by_year(items, substr(d$date, 1, 4)),
     '<p class="empty-filter" hidden>No presentations match.</p>',
     '</div>')
```
